speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (a) whether the Ministry will consider imposing a charge for small disposable carrier bags; (b) how many companies have voluntarily introduced their own disposable bag charge; and (c) if the data is not available, whether the Ministry will start collecting the data.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: Other retailers have the prerogative to decide whether to charge for disposable bags and many have been doing so.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: Nonetheless, we are heartened that many major retailers, including convenience stores, have voluntarily implemented charges.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Could I just ask why are we not keen on tracking how many of these retailers are voluntarily imposing this bag charge?
